encounters.weakness: Alchemist's Knife (player weapon). The knife must be used directly on its form. It cannot be poisoned or damaged by other means. When the knife strikes, it shatters into a cold, crystalline shard that falls to the floor. This shard is a key pickup.

Shard of Stillness (collected from first encounter). The vial must be struck directly with the Shard of Stillness to break. Any contact with the player's body or weapons causes it to activate and release black liquid. The liquid drains stamina and poisons the alchemist's alchemical tools for 10 seconds. If the player is poisoned, they must use a healing vial to recover before continuing to fight it.

Black Sap (collected from the Whispering Vessel). The player must apply the Black Sap directly to the mirror surface. The Sap must be applied within 3 seconds of the mirror's activation. If delayed, the mirror reflects a deeper, distorted version of the player — one that begins to attack autonomously and creates hallucinations. The enemy will only be defeated if the Black Sap is used correctly and at the right time.
Direct flame exposure when used at 70% burn duration (requires sustained, controlled pyromancer fire), not raw blast attacks. If used too aggressively, the Warden explodes and harms the player.
Flame Sigil must be activated within 3 seconds of the enemy's first roar. If not activated, the Chorus emits a psychic echo that causes fire to become uncontrollable and spreads to adjacent zones.
Must be struck with Ignition Core at full power while player stands in the core chamber center. If placed outside or used late, the core stabilizes and becomes immune to flame.

The player's Shadowblade weapon (active state). When the blade is drawn and glowing, the enemy's reflections shatter, causing it to stagger and take 30% damage. If the blade is sheathed, the enemy becomes fully armored and immune to physical attacks for 4 seconds.

Exposed to the Shattered Mirror Fragment. When the fragment is used, the Warden's shadow duplicates freeze and the real entity becomes visible, reducing its health by 40% and revealing its true form (a hollowed figure with no eyes). If the fragment is not used, the Warden creates a shadow clone every 5 seconds, increasing its health by 20% and threatening to overwhelm the player.

Vulnerable to the 'Shadow Shard (Eyes of the First Watcher)' — if the player holds it during a 10-second window when the boss is exposed, it takes 50% damage. If the shard is not present, the boss becomes immune and gains +20% damage resistance and spawns a shadow echo every 3 seconds. The player must survive for 120 seconds before the final attack begins.
inventory: Shadow Shard (Eyes of the First Watcher)

encounters.weakness: Heat from the player's Thermal Rifle (ranger weapon). A burst of thermal energy from the rifle's magazine causes a 15-second freeze burst, freezing the wraith and damaging it by 40%.

Sonic Disruption — the player must use the Sonic Disruptor to jam the enemy's tracking system. Once disrupted, the Ice Hunter becomes disoriented and vulnerable to attacks for 12 seconds. It cannot track movement during this phase.

Sonic Disruptor (pickup from Encounter 2). Requires activation during a specific vulnerability phase to break its form. After using the Sonic Disruptor, the Frost Mind's form fractures, revealing a core that is vulnerable to 35% damage per second for 10 seconds. Must be used during the 'Shattering Phase'.
Necroflame (player weapon)
Soul Shard (a pickup from the first encounter)
Soul Candle (pickup from second encounter)

Berserker's Bloodied Shield (pickup from starting area). The shield absorbs 50% of the Hollow Gorgon's attacks and reflects them back as a shockwave. When the player wields the shield, it glows crimson, and any attack that hits the shield immediately causes a 10% chance of the Gorgon to shatter its own form and drop a 'Cursed Fragment'.

Fang of the Cursed Forge (acquired in previous encounter). When the player strikes the golem with the fang, it emits a howl that shatters its internal gears. This causes it to collapse into a pile of rubble for 3 seconds, and during that time, the player gains a 2-second speed boost and a 10% increased damage. However, if the player does not strike it within 2 seconds, the golem reforms with a new, more aggressive form (gains +25% damage and 15% chance to launch a 'Rage Crush' that deals 100% damage to nearby enemies).

Fang of the Cursed Forge (acquired in Encounter 2). The mirror fragment is a volatile entity that reflects the player's image and attacks them in multiple directions. Each reflection duplicates the mirror's attacks. The player can only defeat it by using the Fang of the Cursed Forge to strike its core directly — the core appears as a black void in the mirror's center. If the player fails to do so within 10 seconds, the fragment explodes, spreading chaos across the area and spawning two additional mirror fragments with the same stats as the original. This triggers the full boss fight in the next phase.
Pulse Baton (player's weapon)
Fragment of Stillness (pickup from Encounter 1)
Echo Key (pickup from Encounter 2)
Mirror (pickup from the environment or player's inventory — used as a reflection tool to break the shadow's form)
Mirror (must be held and pointed directly at the creature to reveal it and freeze it).
Paper Lantern (must be held directly toward the Wraith to stop its rotation and disable its illusions)
The player's 'Steam-Powered Wrench' (equipped as primary weapon) deals 2x damage to this enemy. It can be used to disarm the enemy's hydraulic treads, preventing it from moving.

The Steam-Powered Wrench (from Encounter 1) can be used to disrupt the wraith's internal gear sync. When used on the enemy, it causes a 3-second vulnerability where damage is doubled and the wraith becomes stuck in a rotating loop (cannot move or attack).

Only vulnerable when the player has equipped the 'Rusted Flywheel' (acquired in Encounter 2). Using the flywheel during the fight reduces the boss's damage by 30% and increases player attack speed by 25%. The boss only activates this weakness after being hit once with the player's primary weapon (Steam-Powered Wrench) during the fight.
The player's 'Steam-Tuned Wrench' (a weapon pickup from the starting area); attacks that use the wrench's harmonic vibration trigger a 2x damage effect on the Wraith.

The Resonant Core pickup; if the player holds the Resonant Core and casts 'Harmonic Dissonance' (a spell tied to artificer tech), the enemy's mechanical joints shatter and take 50% damage per hit until defeated.

The player's 'Steam-Tuned Wrench' (a weapon from the first encounter) used in combination with the Fault Line Key. If the wrench is swung while the Fault Line Key is inserted into the Veil-Scourger's left joint, it creates a resonance loop that deals 3x damage for 2 seconds and disables its ability to phase through walls for 5 seconds.
Player's Alchemical Flask (used to contain steam)
Glimmering Soot (scattered over gears)
Moonstone Dew (used on central platform)

Weak to the player's primary weapon — the 'Copper Spine' — which emits a high-frequency harmonic that causes mechanical feedback. A single hit from the Copper Spine reduces enemy health by 40% and causes it to stutter, making it vulnerable for 3 seconds to follow-up attacks. The Spine must be used immediately after the first enemy dies to gain access to the next encounter area.

Weak to the 'Fractured Cog' pickup. When the Fractured Cog is used, it jams the enemy's hydraulic joints, forcing it to freeze for 4 seconds. After freezing, it becomes temporarily inert and vulnerable to any attack. This allows the player to use stealth or sabotage to eliminate it without direct confrontation.

Weak to the 'Soldered Wire' pickup. When the Soldered Wire is thrown into the Wraith's eye socket (a mechanical flaw), it short-circuits its internal energy core, causing it to lose its steam-dampening field and become vulnerable to physical attacks for 6 seconds. The player must use the Soldered Wire in a specific timing window to succeed.

Storm Pulse (pickup from initial environment) — when the player uses their Stormcaller weapon at full charge, the enemy takes 50% more damage and is stunned for 2 seconds. Only available if player has activated a storm pulse in the environment.

Storm Core (player weapon) — when the Stormcaller weapon is used in its charged state, the Iron Sigh takes 75% damage and is stunned for 4 seconds. Must have weapon equipped and fully charged to trigger effect. If weapon is not charged, the enemy gains +20% armor and 30% damage resistance.

Storm Vessel (pickup from second encounter) — when the player uses the Storm Vessel pickup to generate a storm burst, it deals 200% damage to the Hollow Cog. Requires the pickup to be active and the player to be in proximity (within 5 meters). Cannot be used during combat if not in correct state (must have been activated during previous encounter).
Chrono-Blade Time-Frost (freezes enemy mid-action)
Phase Shard (used during rewind to phase through enemy path)
Frozen Moment Shard (used during time-loop phase)
Tectonic Staff (player weapon, emits geothermal pulse when activated - causes 2x damage to gearskull's mechanical joints, which are vulnerable to heat and vibration)
Gravitic Fragment (the fragment creates a localized gravity well that crushes the hydra's segmented limbs, causing them to lose stability and fall apart when the gravity field is active)
Fractured Crystal (must be used in a specific spell to disrupt its core resonance field; if not used, it regenerates health at 15% per second)
Steam Hammer (player's default weapon) - 50% damage reduction when hitting with the Steam Hammer, and additional 25% damage on hit when used in the 'defensive stance'
Oiled Gearblade (acquired from first encounter) - when wielded, the player deals 30% more damage to the Clockwork Lurker and disrupts its internal cogs, forcing it to freeze for 1 turn after each hit

Oiled Gearblade (acquired from second encounter) - when used, the Warden's movement is slowed by 25%, and all its attacks have 30% chance to miss when used in the 'staggered stance' (a passive state when the player has the weapon in hand).
